verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Ghostty shipping its own SSH integration that carries terminfo, shell integration, or config to remote hosts. Community reports say SSH fails out of the box because of Ghostty's TERM value. The fixes users describe are user-side workarounds: SetEnv TERM in ssh config, manually distributing the terminfo and running tic, or following a terminfo help page. Those earn no credit toward a built-in integration.
